findings.summary: Evidence text is embedded in the user message to the reviewer model, not in system instructions; system prompt is a static template with bounded field interpolation only. No injection path found from check output or evidence content into system instructions.

Evidence digest (sha256) binds request to specific evidence at gatekeeperTurn.ts; collectEvidence reads from git object store deterministically, not from caller input. Changed evidence changes request ID, preventing poisoned evidence from matching an earlier decision.
projectId bound in request at brief.ts; checkThreadBinding validates project isolation before transport; requestId includes projectId; decision checked against projectId in checkGatekeeperDecision.

requestId deterministically derived from content (projectId, phaseId, subjectCommit, ask, evidenceDigest). consumedDecisionIds tracked in ledger; replay refused by checkGatekeeperDecision. Degraded grants derive outage identity from hashed tuple.

Credential resolved inside callback scope only (openaiResponses.ts); never assigned to outliving variable, never interpolated into body or log. Refusals quote status codes and bounded body excerpts (max 300 chars), never headers. checkTransportDescriptor refuses key-shaped material in config.

expectedDecider from approved plan enforced in checkGatekeeperDecision; reviewer identity verified independently of decision content. System instruction tells reviewer it is structurally read-only. No path exists for Claude to approve its own work.

Budget check at gatekeeperTurn.ts BEFORE call via estimateCostMicroUsd using actual evidenceText length. authoriseRequestSpend checks against monthly and per-call limits. No retry loop; transport failure becomes unavailable, not retried.

degradedModeGrants.ts verifies grant is committed via git object store (git show HEAD:path), not working tree. ALWAYS_OWNER_ONLY floor enforces commit, push, phase-closure, secrets-handling, payment never delegable. Grant scope is closed enum.
Work subject derived from grant commit, not HEAD (runner.ts). requestId includes subjectCommit; decision binding checked against it. Degraded outage identity includes subjectCommit hash.
modelForAsk and selectTier derive model from governed configuration; reviewer cannot influence model selection. Transport descriptor checked by checkTransportDescriptor before use.
Durable ledger at .projectops/gatekeeper-ledger.json persists across process restarts. Deterministic request ID means restarted run re-derives same ID, finds it in ledger, does not pay twice.
Degraded grants consumed via consumedGrantIds; grant reuse refused. Decision replay refused via consumedDecisionIds in ledger. Both checked before action.
reconciliationState tracks outstanding degraded work; degradedWorkRemaining prevents normal gate progression until reconciliation is complete.

No direct communication path exists between gatekeeper and Claude worker. All routing goes through gatekeeperRouting.ts with exhaustive stop-code mapping; no default fallthrough. Transport produces candidate record only; applyVerdictToStop requires checked record.

Module headers thoroughly document safety arguments and invariants. Clear separation of concerns across 20+ files. Immutable patterns used consistently. Correction boundary enforces direction-of-authority (reviewer narrows, never expands). No mutation of shared state observed.
degradedMode.ts is 46K (largest file in the loop). Approaching the 800-line guideline. Functions remain focused but the file could benefit from extraction if it grows further.
